symptom: ako/mxcli#950 item 1: a page button described as `Action: delete close page` executes to a Forms$DeleteClientAction with ClosePage=false — a describe → exec round trip silently stops the button closing its page; check, exec and mx check are all clean
cause: buildClientActionV3Base's `delete` case did not copy action.ClosePage, although the visitor sets it and the writer (clientActionToGen) writes it; save/cancel copied it
insight: The audit of the other cases found no other dropped visitor flag, but two hard-coded ones describe cannot express: complete task always writes ClosePage/Commit true and show page/create object write NumberOfPagesToClose2 "" — every Studio Pro instance in TestApp/PedApp has those values, so they are latent, not live. A text round trip could not have caught this: describe printed the flag correctly and the second describe of the exec'd page printed `delete`, which looks like a user edit — read the stored ClosePage
